overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for NTNU: headings are read and mapped correctly, learning outcomes keep all Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse groups, and all 14 suspects plus the 5 controls land in the right sections. The 'boilerplate' flags are false alarms (all 14 suspects are PPU Fagdidaktikk 2 plans that share the same genuine template text); remaining issues are minor.

findings.evidence: Vurderingsbesvarelsen skrives på norsk, svensk eller dansk.
findings.description: In the PPU plans the assessment section holds only the general rules (language, resit, complaints). The per-part assessment forms (Vurderingsordning: Fag 2 (Hjemmeeksamen), Fag 1; weighting, grading) are headings mapped to assessment but their content does not appear, while other NTNU plans (e.g. HIST2045, FRA3901) do get a 'Vurderingsordning: ... Karakter: ...' line. The actual exam form is missing from these assessments. Cannot be fully verified because the plan text is truncated in the packet.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Vurderingsordning: <name>' sub-blocks in the multi-part exam layout have content only under sub-headings mapped to .drop (Utsatt eksamen -, Ordinær eksamen -); the heading text/grade info of these parts is not emitted when there are several parts.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the block reader for NTNU Eksamen with multiple 'Vurderingsordning:' headings: emit the 'Vurderingsordning: X / Karakter: Y' lines for each part into assessment, as is done for single-part plans.

findings.evidence: Vekting 100/100 Dato Utlevering  Innlevering  Tid Innlevering  Eksamenssystem Inspera Assessment
findings.description: Exam-logistics table (weighting, empty date fields, exam system) flattened into assessment text, because the 'Ny eksamen -' sub-heading is mapped to assessment while 'Ordinær eksamen -' is dropped. Inconsistent and leaves empty logistic labels.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps 'Ny eksamen -' to assessment but 'Ordinær eksamen -' / 'Utsatt eksamen -' to .drop.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Ny eksamen -' to .drop like the other exam-date sub-headings (or strip the 'Vekting ... Eksamenssystem ...' row).

findings.evidence: Det kreves derfor 75 % oppmøte for å kunne fremstille seg til eksamen i faget.
findings.description: Attendance and approval requirements (a pass/approve gate, coursework_requirements by the codebook) sit inside teaching_methods because NTNU's 'Læringsformer og aktiviteter' text itself contains them. The same statement is also duplicated in assessment/coursework_requirements in SOS2020 ('Alle oppgaver i kurset må være gjennomført og godkjent'). This is source content mixing, only partially fixable.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sections are cut at headings only; no sentence-level reclassification.
findings.suggested_fix: Accept as source-level; optionally document in data notes. Not worth a heading-map change.
